data.exact_reserve_text: The combined effect of the two transactions had no economic impact for the Syndicate, and accordingly there is no impact on the income statement or statement of financial position. Current year underwriting results for the transferred policies have been reported in the same classes of business as in prior years, as the effective date of the transfer was 30 December 2020, and in line with Society of Lloyd's guidance no movements were processed on these policies on 31 December 2020.

named_events.loss_description: adverse claims experience, particularly from natural catastrophes and the losses arising from the Covid-19 pandemic; negatively impacted both the Commercial and Household property classes; heavily impacted Accident & Health business; Unexpired risk provision relates to COVID-19 losses.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported flat prior year development for 2020, primarily due to the transfer of European liabilities to Lloyd's Insurance Company S.A. (LIC) via a Part VII transfer and a 100% Quota Share Reinsurance Agreement. This transaction, effective 30 December 2020, resulted in no movements being processed on these policies for the year, thus showing no change in prior year claims estimates in the development tables. The overall result for the year was impacted by adverse claims experience, particularly from natural catastrophes and losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic, which affected Property and Accident & Health lines.
raw_causal_phrases: no movements were processed on these policies on 31 December 2020
transfer to Lloyd's Insurance Company S.A. (LIC) of syndicates' European liabilities

The Accident & Health business focusses primarily on Personal Accident and Contingency. These classes have been heavily impacted by COVID-19
